project_type: Research ML codebase: TF 2.10 groupwise 3D brain MRI registration (rigid/affine done in milestones 1-5; deformable is milestone 6), NVIDIA DALI 1.18 data pipelines, custom tf.function training loop
language: Python 3.8-compatible (runtime container: Python 3.8.10, TF 2.10.0, DALI 1.18, numpy 1.21.1, scipy 1.4.1). Local test env tf_gpu: Python 3.9, TF 2.10, numpy 1.24, scipy 1.13 (scipy only in tests; no numpy>1.21 APIs in library code; no PEP 585/604 runtime annotations)
build_system: None (plain Python packages models/, data_loading/, runtime/, main.py). No pip installs possible on the cluster.
test_framework: unittest (python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .). Every TF test module imports tests.tf_setup FIRST (TF32 off, 6 GB GPU limit via BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB). Shared helpers in tests/runtime_helpers.py (NARROW model widths, NARROW_ARGS, write_fake_export, synthetic_group, free_memory). DALI tests skip locally (no nvidia.dali in WSL envs). tests/gpu/ is NOT discovered (glacier-only scripts).
build_command: Syntax: wsl -d Ubuntu bash -lc "cd /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad && source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate bgr_preproc38 && python -m py_compile models/*.py data_loading/*.py runtime/*.py main.py tests/*.py tests/gpu/*.py"
test_command: Single modules: wsl -d Ubuntu bash -lc "cd /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad && source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate tf_gpu && TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=3 TF_CUDNN_WORKSPACE_LIMIT_IN_MB=512 BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000 TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m unittest tests.test_diffeo -v" (helper: .agents/tasks/milestone-5/run_some.sh <modules>). Full suite (~70-90 min, run in background and poll): wsl -d Ubuntu bash /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/tests/run_tests_wsl.sh
verification_instructions: 1) py3.8 syntax check (run_tests_wsl.sh stage 1 also does ast feature_version=(3,8), TF-free import of runtime.args and `main.py --help`, bash -n of tests/gpu/run_verify_glacier.sh, tests/gpu/run_overfit_glacier.sh, slurm/train_debug.sh). 2) Run the unit tests of every touched module with the single-module command. 3) Existing tests must keep passing unchanged except the deliberate updates listed in plan.md section 1 item 6. 4) The final step runs the full suite after the last edit and stores it in .agents/tasks/milestone-6/test-log.txt.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in by build/test. Deliverables written by hand: .agents/tasks/milestone-6/{report.md, test-log.txt, memory.json, overfit_summary_deform_*.json}; design.md bump to v3.7.
environment_constraints: Windows host + WSL Ubuntu; local GPU is an 8 GB GTX 1080 (tests cap TF at 6 GB; narrow widths for training tests; TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0). The tf_gpu env crashes CPU-only: never hide the GPU. Do NOT ssh to Martinos, do NOT run on glacier or SLURM (a training job is running from committed code), do NOT git commit or push (this overrides any generic 'commit locally' instruction). Never modify reference/ (gitignored, read-only). Use the PowerShell tool only for wsl/git status; file edits through the editor tools. Long test runs: run_in_background and poll; the full suite takes over an hour.
contribution_requirements: Obey .kiro/steering/project-state.md and cluster-access.md. Python 3.8 syntax. Match existing style: module docstrings that document conventions, numpy-reference unit tests, dataclass configs, TF-free runtime/args.py, Python-side trace counters in tf.functions. TF32 must stay off (models.precision.configure_tf_precision). Sampling grids never float16. Keep linear-task defaults and checkpoints unchanged (plan.md section 1).
key_patterns: Conventions (plan.md section 0, design.md section 2): arrays [N,X,Y,Z,C], group = batch axis 0 (N dynamic, one group per batch); voxel p at world (p-(n-1)/2)*s; fields in voxel units of their level; pull warps out(x)=in(x+u(x)); compose(a,b)=phi_a o phi_b = u_b + warp_field(u_a,u_b) with border clamping for fields, zero fill for images/one-hots; inverse = exp(-v); pairwise onehot_i -> j via compose(u_i, u_inv_j); trilinear x2 with coarse q at fine 2q+0.5 (half-pixel, edge replicate). Group blocks: models.layers.GroupConvBlock (pre-activation norm->act->concat(group mean)->conv), _conv_block helper in models/group_net.py. Trainer (runtime/run.py): one tf.function per task (input_signature from dali_loader signatures), self.trace_counts[task] += 1 inside the body, ONE optimizer built on all trainable vars in __init__ (O.build_optimizer), static None-grad filter, finite flag + tf.cond apply + BN moving-stat rollback, step.assign_add. Post-processing outside the tape (data_loading/postprocess.py LinearPostprocess pattern, seeded tf.random.Generator, sample_pairs/apply_flip). Validation: fixed groups (runtime/fixed_data.py ValidationSet pattern), eval mode is the source of truth, train-mode diagnostic forward restores BN stats; numpy metrics in runtime/metrics.py with summarize(prefix). PNGs: runtime/val_png.py (Agg, axial mid slice, R on left, anterior up). CLI flags in runtime/args.py, TrainConfig/ModelConfig dataclasses; config.json via checkpoint.write_config.
directory_structure: models/ (layers, transforms, group_net, config, precision; new diffeo), data_loading/ (params: constants and DALI formulas, TF/DALI-free; dali_loader: pipelines, imports without DALI; data_module: manifest + DALIDatasets; postprocess: TF post-DALI processing), runtime/ (run: Trainer; losses; metrics (numpy); fixed_data: phantoms, fixed groups, validation sets; val_png; args (TF-free CLI); checkpoint; curriculum; logging; optimizers; schedulers), main.py (entry point), tests/ (unittest; tests/gpu = glacier scripts, not discovered), slurm/ (job templates), preprocessing/ (data export, Jay runs it), .agents/tasks/<milestone>/ (plans, reports, logs), reference/ (read-only reference projects)
